pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai Red Ninja Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai, the Red Ninja, faces forward in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing a crested hood and simple wrap-front uniform above a tied waist sash. A sword handle rises behind one shoulder, with the lower end visible beside his hand. Thick outlines and broad minifigure limbs create uncomplicated spaces across the standing portrait.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai Fire Ninja with Fire Sword Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai holds a fire sword in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, its tall flame-shaped blade rising beside his masked head and armored shoulder above the hilt. Round chest fastenings and small angular motifs decorate his uniform. Rocks and part of a curved temple roof provide a simple setting behind the Fire Ninja.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai Using Fire Powers Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai uses his fire powers in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with flames curling around both raised hands and forming a large pointed outline behind his head. His focused eyes show through the folded mask. Broad uniform panels and the knotted sash contrast with the narrower tongues of fire around the upper-body figure.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai Performing Fire Spinjitzu Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai performs fire Spinjitzu in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, holding a sword as a tapering vortex of curved flames wraps around his body below. A second sword handle appears behind his shoulder. The dragon-like chest motif, tied sash, mask crest, and repeated sweeping fire bands define the spinning action.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai Zx Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai ZX stands ready in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a sword strapped across his back and a raised shoulder guard beside his hood. Crossed torso straps meet an angular chest plate over the uniform. Small buckles, a tied sash, block feet, and sparse geometric background accents complete the armored minifigure portrait.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai Dx Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai DX appears in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with spiky uncovered hair, a lower-face mask, and a dragon-head emblem centered across his chest straps. A sword handle rises behind one shoulder. A gateway and dragon-shaped background ornament frame his simple full-body stance, tied sash, curved hands, and rectangular feet.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai Nrg Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai NRG stands surrounded by flames in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, wearing a mask and uniform covered with smaller outlined fire motifs across the torso. A single shoulder guard projects beside his hood. The repeated flame patterns on his forehead, chest, and legs contrast with the large fire shapes behind him.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai Tournament of Elements Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai stands with folded arms in this Lego Ninjago Tournament of Elements printable coloring page, wearing a crested mask above a simple wrap-front uniform and sash. Large spiral motifs fill the background behind his upper body. The rounded crossed sleeves contrast with block-shaped feet and broad trouser panels in the full-length pose.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai with Element Blades Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai crosses two Element Blades in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, gripping the striped handles so the long curved swords form an X before his chest. His focused eyes remain visible above the mask. An arched outline frames the portrait, with the knotted sash and broad uniform sections beneath the intersecting weapons.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai with Fire Dragon Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai stands with a Fire Dragon in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, raising one minifigure hand as the large winged creature stretches its neck behind him. Open jaws reveal pointed teeth above a banded throat. Mountains, clouds, a dragon chest emblem, and Kai's tied sash complete the two-subject adventure scene.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai in Monastery Courtyard Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai stands in a monastery courtyard in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with a sword crossing his torso beneath shoulder armor and a flame-marked hood. Arched wooden doors rise behind him beside tiled roofing, a small tree, and a lantern. Cracked paving and a flame chest plate add detail around the central figure.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai in Monastery of Spinjitzu Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai visits the Monastery of Spinjitzu in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing with his hands at his hips and crossed sword handles behind his shoulders. A dragon medallion hangs above the open gateway behind him. Costume emblems, wrapped legs, tiled roofs, steps, and a small shaped tree fill the monastery setting.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai in Tournament Temple City Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai stands in Tournament Temple City in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, with spiky hair exposed above his mask and two sword handles rising behind his shoulders. Flame emblems decorate his chest armor beside a crossed strap. Arched doorways, curved roofs, distant towers, and low stone walls surround the waist-up minifigure.

pages.title: Lego Ninjago Kai in Ninja Dojo Temple Coloring Page
pages.description: Kai holds a sword inside the Ninja Dojo Temple in this Lego Ninjago printable coloring page, standing on a plank floor before tall paneled doors behind him. A hanging scroll and low bench sit along one wall. His shoulder guards, flame emblem, belt pouches, tied sash, and wrapped legs offer detailed costume sections.
